services.desc: Red Snapper/bottom fishing may have a little further travel time (30+ miles) but is well worth it when you hook up on the big one! Snapper fishing is one of the most desired charter fishing trips we offer. You will have an opportunity to catch snapper or a grouper while bottom fishing and when we reach our limit, we will try to fill the box with other offshore fish at the rigs or around the barrier islands. These trips are always a favorite! You will have an opportunity to catch snapper or a grouper while bottom fishing with an opportunity for very large fish. blurb: SYL Charters offers fishing trips off the Biloxi coast targeting species such as Red Snapper, Cobia, Redfish, Trout, Sheepshead, and Spanish Mackerel. Trips range from inshore family fishing to offshore trophy fishing on a 32' Bertram sport fisher. The boat is equipped with modern electronics, safety equipment, and a private bathroom.
